statement_nl: For each j in P, the sizes j-1 and n-j are both less than n. If one of these sizes is at least 2, apply the induction hypothesis from A2 to the corresponding subpattern; if it is 0 or 1, use the direct equalities U_0(empty) = E_0 = 1 and U_1(empty) = E_1 = 1. Therefore, for every j in P, U_{j-1}(p_j) <= E_{j-1} and U_{n-j}(q_j) <= E_{n-j}. Hence each summand in A3 is at most w_j := binom(n-1, j-1) * E_{j-1} * E_{n-j}.
